name: hogaria
description: HogarIA: household, shopping, kitchen and AI on a single Raspberry Pi

scripts.dev: concurrently --names CLIENT,SERVER --prefix-colors cyan,yellow "pnpm --filter @hogaria/web run start" "pnpm --filter @hogaria/server run dev"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:server && pnpm run build:client
scripts.test: pnpm run test:config && pnpm run test:client && pnpm run test:server
scripts.test:config: node --test --experimental-test-isolation=none scripts/karma-coverage-gate.test.mjs scripts/check-ui-button-geometry.test.mjs scripts/ci-e2e-timeout.test.mjs scripts/node-test-config.test.mjs scripts/ai-live-existing-webapi.test.mjs scripts/ai-live-smoke-safety.test.mjs scripts/ai-live-smoke-runner-control.test.mjs scripts/run-household-meal-real-smoke.test.mjs scripts/check-push-format.test.mjs scripts/check-ui-component-styles.test.mjs scripts/format-staged-files.test.mjs scripts/container-smoke.test.mjs scripts/nginx-static-headers-smoke.test.mjs scripts/ci-delivery-workflows.test.mjs scripts/check-image-platforms.test.mjs scripts/read-image-manifest-digest.test.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run test:client:coverage && pnpm run test:server:coverage
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:client && pnpm run lint:server
scripts.lint:client: pnpm run check:ui && pnpm --filter @hogaria/web run lint
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm run lint:client:fix && pnpm run lint:server:fix
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules frontend/node_modules server/node_modules frontend/dist server/dist
